content.json:
## Sword AI Summit workshop - participant usage
Training use only; synthetic data. Token metrics come from the APIM `llm-emit-token-metric` policy (namespace `care-workshop`, dimension **User ID** = participant). Requests come from the APIM Application Insights diagnostic (W3C correlation). If token tiles are empty, enable *custom metrics with dimensions* on the Application Insights resource (see infra README).

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ("Total Tokens", "Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens")
| extend participant = tostring(customDimensions["User ID"]), model = tostring(customDimensions["Model"])
| summarize total = sumif(valueSum, name == "Total Tokens"), prompt = sumif(valueSum, name == "Prompt Tokens"), completion = sumif(valueSum, name == "Completion Tokens") by participant, model
| order by total desc
content.title: Tokens per participant

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| extend participant = tostring(customDimensions["User ID"])
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by participant, bin(timestamp, 5m)
content.title: Token usage over time

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend route = case(url has "/openai/", "openai", url has "/care-tools/", "mcp", url has "/a2a/care-knowledge", "a2a", url has "/foundry/", "foundry", url has "/telemetry/", "telemetry", "other")
| summarize calls = count(), errors = countif(success == false), p50_ms = percentile(duration, 50), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by route
| order by calls desc
content.title: Latency and errors per route

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend participant = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]), tostring(customDimensions["Request-x-participant-id"]), tostring(customDimensions["Backend Request-x-participant-id"]), "unknown")
| extend route = case(url has "/openai/", "openai", url has "/care-tools/", "mcp", url has "/a2a/care-knowledge", "a2a", url has "/foundry/", "foundry", url has "/telemetry/", "telemetry", "other")
| where route != "telemetry"
| summarize calls = count(), errors = countif(success == false), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by participant, route
| order by participant asc, route asc
content.title: Latency and errors per participant

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url has "/care-tools/"
| extend participant = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]), tostring(customDimensions["Request-x-participant-id"]), tostring(customDimensions["Backend Request-x-participant-id"]), "unknown")
| summarize calls = count(), errors = countif(success == false), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by operation_Name, participant
| order by calls desc
content.title: MCP tool calls by operation

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where target has "care-tools-backend"
| summarize calls = count(), failures = countif(success == false), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by name, resultCode
| order by calls desc
content.title: MCP backend calls (tool executions)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url has "/a2a/care-knowledge"
| extend participant = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]), tostring(customDimensions["Request-x-participant-id"]), tostring(customDimensions["Backend Request-x-participant-id"]), "unknown")
| extend kind = iff(url has "agent-card", "agent card", "JSON-RPC")
| summarize calls = count(), errors = countif(success == false), p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by participant, kind
| order by calls desc
content.title: A2A calls to the base agent

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where success == false
| extend participant = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]), tostring(customDimensions["Request-x-participant-id"]), tostring(customDimensions["Backend Request-x-participant-id"]), "unknown")
| extend route = case(url has "/openai/", "openai", url has "/care-tools/", "mcp", url has "/a2a/care-knowledge", "a2a", url has "/foundry/", "foundry", url has "/telemetry/", "telemetry", "other")
| project timestamp, participant, route, name, resultCode, duration, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
| take 50
content.title: Errors (last 50)
